reason: The Mercury logo link to /redirect has an SVG wordmark with no title, aria-label or text, so the tree exposes link with an empty name and it fails 4.1.2 and 2.4.4. It is a secondary home shortcut: View loan details and Make Another Request carry the visible next steps, so the task is not blocked and the impact is minor.

The confirmation You've requested $250,000 USD from your Venture Debt loan replaces the form in place on the same URL, outside any live region: the page's only role=alert node is the empty toast container, focus drops to body, the title is unchanged and the page has no heading. It is the only confirmation of a money movement, so a screen-reader user hears nothing after submitting.
